text_blocks.snippet: To do a COVID-19 test, you will typically need to collect a sample from your nose using a swab, and then perform the test according to the instructions provided with your test kit. Most at-home tests involve inserting the swab into one nostril, rotating it, and then repeating in the other nostril. The sample is then processed and the result is read directly from the test device.
snippet_highlighted_words: collect a sample from your nose using a swab, and then perform the test according to the instructions provided with your test kit

list.title: 1. Obtain a test kit:
list.snippet: You can purchase COVID-19 at-home test kits from various retailers or online.

list.title: 2. Prepare the test:
list.snippet: Follow the instructions included with your specific test kit. This usually involves opening the test package and preparing the necessary components.
Remove the swab from its packaging, avoiding touching the soft end.
Insert the swab into one nostril, no more than 3/4 of an inch, and gently rotate it.
Remove the swab and repeat the process in the other nostril using the same swab.

list.title: 4. Perform the test:
list.snippet: Follow the instructions for your specific test, which may involve placing the swab into a solution, applying the sample to a test strip, or other methods.

list.title: 5. Read the results:
list.snippet: Most at-home tests provide results within a short period of time. Follow the instructions to interpret the results correctly.
